caseStudy.role: Frontend Architect & Educational Tool Developer
caseStudy.problem: Faculty members teaching diverse technical courses struggled to submit complete, consistent syllabus specifications and teaching parameters. Unstructured submissions lacked textbook copyright verification under AACCUP accreditation standards, had inconsistent grading breakdowns, and failed to account for department-specific laboratory equipment limits, leading to weeks of manual revision.
caseStudy.architecture: Modern edge application built with Astro 5 and React 19 islands, deployed on Cloudflare Workers with KV persistence (env.INTAKE_STORE) and pass-code protected administrator export. Connects an in-memory searchable catalog of 157 ZPPSU courses with reactive client-side validation rules enforcing a strict 100% grading allocation and AACCUP 5-year textbook recency constraints.
features: 157-Course Live Autocomplete: Instant fuzzy-search connecting Computer Technology (CpT), Electrical (ELT), and Electronics (ELX)
7-Step Guided Intake Flow: Course Info, Lab Constraints, Student Profiles, Grading, References, Preferences, and Signatories
Interactive Grading Weight Sliders: Real-time visual balance sliders strictly enforcing a 100% total assessment constraint
AACCUP Recency Validation: Validates textbook publication dates against the official 5-year accreditation recency threshold
Department-Specific Lab Presets: Customizes hardware, software, and safety constraints based on technical specialization
4-Tier Institutional Signatory Matrix: Formats official review hierarchies across Instructor, Chair, Dean, and VPAA
One-Click Profile JSON Export: Produces structured intake schemas formatted for downstream AI syllabus and lesson plan generators
Cloudflare Edge & KV Store: Edge-rendered on Cloudflare Workers with secure administrative review and data persistence
caseStudy.outcome: Accelerated the faculty syllabus onboarding process across 3 engineering departments, ensuring 100% mathematical validity in grading breakdowns and instant compatibility with automated AI syllabus compilation pipelines.
